_comment: All-neural deployed stack: the three real neural networks in the flight, control included. mlp_control = the low-level MLP flight CONTROLLER (input = body state + linear/angular velocities + steer command + last action -> output = 4-D thrust/moment to the motors), run via record_sensor_demo --controller rl. fused_full = the all-sensor nav net (in the FLIGHT this is the larger LSTMNetViT-style FusedSensorViT v19; in the SCHEDULE it is fused_full's compiled dispatch graph as the nav-lane proxy until the ViT compiles, req 010). yolov8_nano_64x96 = FPV detector, the DOMINATING net sharded across harts. This makes control a real DNN (more realistic than the analytic Lee law), accepting slightly worse flight for a genuine neural control loop. Periods = real firing rates; num_instances RT-driven. A LARGER mlp_control is a follow-on (recompile via Agent A).
